ABOUT CONGRESSMAN DONALD NORCROSS

Born and raised in South Jersey, Donald is an electrician by trade and a proud union member. In Congress, he is committed to improving the lives of working families by focusing on the issues that matter most to them: raising wages and strengthening our economy, ensuring affordable access to a high-quality education, and supporting the brave men and women that protect our nation and our neighborhoods.

Priorities for South Jerseyans

Creating an American Made Economy

Donald knows the best social program in the world is a good-paying job. That’s why he works tirelessly to put South Jersey workers at the center of federal policymaking, ensuring everyone can get ahead in our economy. He believes all people deserve fair wages, safe working conditions, secure retirement benefits, and a voice in the workplace.

Read More

Opening Doors for Students

The cornerstone of the American Dream has been opportunity. As a member of the House Education and Labor Committee, Donald believes we must provide everyone with access to a robust educational pipeline from pre-K to high school and beyond, ensuring we can pursue our full potential. South Jersey students must have access to the best educational opportunities available, including traditional four-year colleges, registered apprenticeships, and vocational training.

Read More

Making Health Care More Affordable for All

Access to high-quality health care is critical to our prosperity as a nation. No family should have to choose between paying for care and putting food on the table. That’s why Donald works to expand health care access in South Jersey, lower prescription drug prices, and ensure veterans receive the care they deserve.

Read More

Safeguarding Democracy at Home and Abroad

America is based on the promise that everyone has a say in our government. Donald knows that promise isn’t guaranteed. That’s why he is committed to protecting the right to vote and ensuring the interiority of our elections at home and using America’s status as a world leader to support peaceful democracies abroad.

Read More
